dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Cheesecake was surrendered as a stray so we have no history on his behavior in a home environment. Cheesecake has shown fearful behavior while at the care center, trembling and tucking his tail, avoiding handling, and showing reluctance to enter and exit his kennel. Due to his fearfulness, we recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based) and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
dog.name: Cheesecake
